description.narrative:
The proposed project will support to (i) deploy the distributed renewable energy systems in remote and less developed regions in Mongolia, and (ii) enhance capacity of local public utilities in investment planning, project management, and grid control for sustainable renewable energy upscaling in the targeted region. Upon successful completion, the project delivers clean electricity to 70,000 households while annually avoiding 82,789 tons of carbon dioxide emission.
The impact will be imported electricity reduced and energy security improved. The outcome will be renewable energy supply in the country increased. The output will be (i) renewable energy capacity addition for electricity and heating supply in remote grid systems implemented, and (ii) capacity of local public utilities in investment planning, project management, and grid control enhanced.

Output: Shallow-ground heat pump system developed Indicator: 500 kilowatts of shallow-ground heat pumps are installed in the five selected aimag (province) centers by 2023 Achievement: 0.135 Progress/Status: SGHP Batch 1 (Khovd): Completed. The system was commissioned and turned over in Sep 2021, and accepted in Jan 2022.
SGHP Batch 2 (Uliastai and Bayankhongor): Uliastai is completed, state commissioning was done on 5 Apr 2023. Additional works may be needed to enable full system operation. A technical report will be made. Bayankhongor SGHP contract were signed on 20 May 2023 and construction is at 48% and to be completed within 2025 with a change of heat pump manufacturer.
SGHP Batch 3 (Ulaangom and Altai): Contracts were signed on 20 May 2023. Ulaangom SGHP construction is at 50%. Altai SGHP construction is at 35%. Based on meeting with MOE State Secretary in Sep 2025, the contracts for Ulaangom and Altai may need to be terminated. Altai soum buildings will be connected to a centralized district heating system and selected building in Ulaangom school is twice bigger the capacity of planned system.
